binding_values: Exact original launch/ownership/cookie/source/ELF plus actual owned window, root, initial geometry, dark theme and scale_factor1.0; fixed viewport after layout.
fixture_log: Launch pins the exclusive original private ui.log path/device/inode/uid/mode0600/link1 before the standard runner redirects UI stdout+stderr to that same inode. Both readers use bounded4MiB original-FD reads with full before/after/named identity and complete-record checks. Controller proves exact scene/phase/original work twice before either nonpointer operation. After positive family settlement the wrapper retains exact bytes and closes its original log FD before case settlement/C release. Runner stdout/stderr remain separate service evidence. Growth, replacement, partial records or any failure refuses; no retry. Any snapshot read/identity/size/write/fsync/close failure leaves the case unsettled and C retained; the original close is attempted once and its exact outcome is recorded.
output: Original command stdout/stderr/status/waits/family, retained source/build/launch/ownership, frame hashes, per-operation evidence, source oracles and final unknown/closure/cleanliness. No automatic PASS.
pixel_rule: Whole-frame RGB equality for pointer/hover/Tab. Initial resize and fixed F8 instead bind original scene/work and retain full unmasked RGB differences. No other exceptions.
predecessor: Exact immediately preceding successful original phase path/SHA; no incomplete/replayed/reordered phase may be bypassed.
purpose: Manual source-bound root/client review data, not an allocation or UX verdict
target_values: Exact phase role/label/subject/ordinal/occurrences; unique actual enabled unoccluded widget rectangle for click/hover; whole actual owned window for fixed nonpointer operations. F8 target is explicitly NOT a widget.
